base.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: spherical panorama texture for a Bible exploration game
Primary request: Acts 8, Philip with the Ethiopian court official on the desert road from Jerusalem toward Gaza. Generate one extraordinarily detailed cinematic photorealistic historically grounded full 360 by 180 degree environment as a true 2:1 equirectangular spherical panorama, at the largest native panoramic resolution available.
Camera: eye level 1.65 metres, standing on dusty ground right next to the chariot and the two men on the road. The viewer is INSIDE the roadside encounter, with clear near story clues distributed around the sphere. Continuous left and right edges, accurate equirectangular spherical distortion and wraparound; upper half sky, lower half ground. No black bands. The sphere's poles are natural plain sky and continuous ground, no artificial radial starburst or pinwheel.
Essential scene: nearby on an ancient wooden travelling chariot, or standing just beside its open side, a dignified dark-skinned Ethiopian court official wears ancient fine woven court robes, cream linen with muted rich sash and restrained gold trim, no crown. He holds a partly unfurled scroll of Isaiah in both hands, parchment and wooden rollers clearly visible. Its small faded script is indistinct and unreadable, not a title or legible text. Philip, an ordinary first-century Jewish man with a dark beard, plain undyed linen tunic and brown wool cloak, stands beside him explaining the scroll with a natural gesture. Both men are close enough to see realistic faces and the scroll; they look at one another or the scroll. The modest historically plausible chariot has two large weathered wooden wheels, simple curved wooden rail, leather bindings and an open platform with a small cloth canopy; it is drawn by a pair of ordinary horses with ancient simple harness, attended by one modestly dressed driver. A small real freshwater pool or spring lies close to the road, unmistakably visible with reeds, damp edges and an accessible shallow bank, appropriate to the official noticing water nearby and the baptism context. Dry rocky Judean southern landscape, sandy road continuing toward low hills in both directions, sparse grasses, scrub, a few distant travelers and natural sandstone outcrops. A few humble bedrolls and travel jars by the chariot are period authentic. Distribute these clues around the continuous environment: nearby men and scroll, chariot and horses, water and reeds, and the continuing road and distant travelers. Do not repeat the men as duplicate scenes.
Style: maximum intricate cinematic photographic detail, weathered woodgrain, leather harness, cloth fibres and embroidery, parchment texture, dust on sandals, realistic Ethiopian complexion and Philip's weathered skin. Warm natural afternoon light, believable first-century Judean roadside environment, immersive ground-level spherical perspective.
Avoid: Egyptian pyramids, Egyptian Pharaoh headdresses, pharaonic robes, giant hypothetical temples, modern church, domed palace, palace courtyard, modern carriage, rubber tires, modern road, fantasy armor, magical beams, crowns, crosses, modern suits, readable letters or labels, giant books, UI, captions, watermark, collage or split image. No graphic violence.
base.output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/scratch/e03eb0da42dd/generated_images as /workspace/scratch/e03eb0da42dd/generated_images/exec-03abecb5-3eb2-4a46-b8fd-aacd6e495936.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
